LifecycleExecutionResourcesImpactedSumma.description: Contains details for an image resource that was identified for a lifecycle action.

HasImpactedResources.description: Indicates whether an image resource that was identified for a lifecycle action has associated resources that are also impacted.

LifecycleExecutionState.description: The current state of the lifecycle execution.

Status.description: The runtime status of the lifecycle execution.

schema.description: Represents a runtime instance of an EC2 Image Builder lifecycle policy. Lifecycle executions are created automatically when a lifecycle policy runs or when StartResourceStateUpdate is called.

ResourceArn.description: The ARN of the Image Builder resource for which to list lifecycle executions.

Arn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the lifecycle execution.

EndTime.description: The timestamp when the lifecycle runtime instance completed.

LifecycleExecutionId.description: The unique identifier for the lifecycle execution.

ResourceArn.description: The ARN of the Image Builder resource for which to list lifecycle executions.

StartTime.description: The timestamp when the lifecycle runtime instance started.
